p.write_text('from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # Split at the uniform separator. Compare corresponding cells across it.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if sep == 0 or all(grid[r][sep] == grid[0][sep] for r in range(h)):
        # Vertical split: preserve left side; mark exact matches.
        left_w = sep
        right_start = sep + 1
        return [[3 if grid[r][c] == grid[r][right_start + c] else grid[r][c] for c in range(left_w)] for r in range(h)]
    # Horizontal split: use the lower panel background as the output color.
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]
    base = Counter(v for row in lower for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if grid[r][c] == grid[sep + 1 + r][c] else base for c in range(w)] for r in range(sep)]
')

        left_w = sep
        right_start = sep + 1
        return [[3 if grid[r][c] == grid[r][right_start + c] else grid[r][c] for c in range(left_w)] for r in range(h)]
    # Horizontal split: use the lower panel background as the output color.
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]
    base = Counter(v for row in lower for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
